subject: Co-sell Entitlement Mapping & Cross-cloud Listing Playbook
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya@cloudforge.io>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Co-sell entitlement mapping & pilot proposal — CloudForge x Redwood

Hi Rishi / Ben / Grace,

Thanks again for the intro at the summit — excited to follow up. CloudForge is looking to publish a cross-cloud listing (AWS/GCP/Azure) and we want to align entitlement and co-sell routing so customers see consistent SKUs and buy paths regardless of marketplace. High-level asks: 

- Map Redwood sellwith/co-sell entitlements to CloudForge SKUs for AWS, GCP, Azure (how do we surface Redwood credits / demo credits?).
- Define evidence/lite-eval needed for each marketplace (metering, telemetry proof points, reseller entitlements).
- Pilot scope: 3 months, initial listing on AWS + private offer on GCP, with co-sell enablement for 2 joint customers.

I've attached a short product brief and a proposed pilot checklist (CloudForge_Product_Brief.pdf). Can we schedule a 30-min sync next week to agree owners and a timeline? Time windows we prefer: Tue/Wed 9–11am PT.

Also looping in Ethan at Lighthouse Consulting — they will run the marketplace legal/contracting intake for CloudForge.

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Head of Partnerships
CloudForge Solutions
attachments: CloudForge_Product_Brief.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB)
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: Maya Patel <maya@cloudforge.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2026 13:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Co-sell entitlement mapping & pilot proposal — CloudForge x Redwood

Maya — thanks for the brief and the clear asks. Happy to run the entitlement mapping and pilot plan with you. Quick notes and proposed owners: 

- Entitlement mapping / SKU translation: Ben will own the SKU mapping and buyer entitlements.
- Metering / evidence checklist: Grace will collect and validate telemetry examples expected by AWS/GCP/Azure.
- Pilot ops and co-sell motion: I will coordinate the joint-customer playbook and credits.

We can take Tue 9:30am PT for a 30-min kickoff. I've tentatively booked it on our side (calendar invite to follow). Please confirm which two customers you'd like to include in the pilot (initial candidates OK).

Pre-call asks (to make the session productive):
- Share a quick SOW template or expected commercial model for pilot (term, credits, trial limits).
- Any current marketplace listings you already maintain (links).
- Sample metering telemetry or a short demo recording of service provisioning.

Ethan / Lighthouse — welcome; we'll need a point of contact from legal for the private offer and PO redlines.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
Signature: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Co-sell entitlement mapping & pilot proposal — CloudForge x Redwood

Internal notes before the kickoff (attaching initial template).

Key items I want us prepared with on Tue: 
1) Entitlement matrix draft (CloudForge SKU -> Redwood contract product -> marketplace SKU mapping) — see entitlement_template.xlsx attached.
2) Metering evidence expectations per cloud: AWS (CloudWatch + CloudTrail slices), GCP (Stackdriver + billing export), Azure (UsageInsight + metering tags).
3) Co-sell handoff: what signals trigger sales alerting (trial conversion > $X, usage threshold, demo completed).
4) Billing routing: private offers vs marketplace purchase flow — who takes invoice responsibility (Redwood or CloudForge) and how reseller commissions are applied.

Action items before call: 
- Grace: pull two sample telemetry exports from our previous ISV pilot (anonymized).
- Jordan: prepare a short one-pager on how Redwood issues demo/credit SKUs (to discuss interplay with private offer).
- Rishi: confirm pilot customer names and draft the SOW outline.

Attachments: entitlement_template.xlsx (Excel, 45KB)

— Ben
From: Ethan Liu <ethan.liu@lighthouse.consulting>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: Maya Patel <maya@cloudforge.io>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Co-sell entitlement mapping & pilot proposal — CloudForge x Redwood

Thanks all — confirming the Tue 9:30am PT slot and attaching the HubSpot deal link and a lightweight legal intake doc. CloudForge will nominate two pilot accounts this afternoon (both in the retail analytics vertical).

Quick notes from legal: for private offers we will likely request Redwoods standard co-sell addendum + a three-month pilot SOW. I attached a short checklist and our contracting contact (contracts@cloudforge.io).

Links/attachments: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/1198 (HubSpot), https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-cloudforge-pilot (shared drive), contracting_contact.txt (contracts@cloudforge.io).

Maya will upload the SOW draft and demo recording to the drive. See you Tue.

— Ethan, Lighthouse Consulting
